meta.subject: Add AXI protocol checker & fix bug with wlast handling

en.summary: This is a clear DUT protocol bug-fix in the L2 AXI writeback path: WLAST is now generated from the next burst position rather than a ready-gated previous-beat condition, so backpressure no longer shifts the end-of-burst marker.
why_it_counts: The functional change is in a central hardware AXI interface module.
The patch corrects write-burst protocol behavior, not just observability.
The commit adds assertions and a protocol checker that directly validate the repaired behavior.
evidence: hardware/core/l2_axi_bus_interface.sv changes m_wlast from a condition using s_wready and burst_offset_ff == BURST_BEATS - 2 to burst_offset_nxt == BURST_BEATS - 1.
The commit message explicitly says fix bug with wlast handling.
tests/unit/test_l2_axi_handshake.sv adds an assertion that m_wlast equals axi_burst_offset == 15 on the last beat.
The same commit adds an AXI protocol checker, consistent with a real write-channel protocol repair.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: On a burst write channel, the last-beat marker must align with the final transferred beat even when the slave inserts wait states. If WLAST is derived from a ready-gated previous counter state instead of the next accepted burst index, backpressure can cause the last marker to assert one beat early, one beat late, or inconsistently across stalls.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A multi-beat write burst experiences wait states or other conditions where the transfer counter and handshake do not advance every cycle.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Generate the last-beat signal from a stale or ready-gated counter condition instead of the next burst index.
portability_notes: This applies to any burst protocol that has a dedicated last-beat signal, not only AXI.
The key mistake is coupling terminal-beat detection to the wrong cycle of the counter or to the current ready input.
Keep the burst data path unchanged so the failure is specifically a protocol-timing error.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the burst counter and the logic that drives the write-channel last-beat flag.
Change the last-beat predicate so it references the prior counter value plus a ready condition, or otherwise uses stale state instead of the next accepted beat number.
Leave the counter update logic unchanged so stalls create divergence between data progress and the terminal marker.
Exercise a burst with inserted wait states to expose the protocol violation.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: WLAST generation in the L2 AXI write-transfer state machine
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes axi_bus.m_wlast to assert when state_nxt is STATE_WRITE_TRANSFER and burst_offset_nxt equals BURST_BEATS - 1, removing the old dependency on s_wready and burst_offset_ff == BURST_BEATS - 2.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In l2_axi_bus_interface.sv, change axi_bus.m_wlast back to the older expression that depends on axi_bus.s_wready and the previous burst_offset_ff value instead of burst_offset_nxt.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under write-channel backpressure, the final-beat marker becomes misaligned with the data beats, causing AXI protocol violations, potential writeback corruption, or a stalled write response path.
evidence_for_injection: The DUT change is a narrow single-expression fix on WLAST generation.
The added unit assertion checks exactly the intended last-beat alignment.
The repaired logic references the next counter state, which is the standard way to survive wait states.
notes: This is a good reusable fault because many memory fabrics have the same counter-versus-handshake last-beat hazard.
No broader refactor is needed; the one-line reverse edit is sufficient.

zh.summary: 这是 L2 AXI 写回路径中的一个明确 DUT 协议修复：WLAST 现在由下一个 burst 位置生成，而不是依赖 ready 的前一拍条件，因此在回压下也不会错置 burst 结束标志。
why_it_counts: 功能改动发生在核心硬件 AXI 接口模块中。
补丁修正的是写 burst 协议行为，而不是仅仅增加可观测性。
提交同时加入了直接验证该行为的断言和协议检查器。
evidence: hardware/core/l2_axi_bus_interface.sv 把 m_wlast 从依赖 s_wready 且 burst_offset_ff == BURST_BEATS - 2 的条件改成了 burst_offset_nxt == BURST_BEATS - 1。
提交信息明确写了 fix bug with wlast handling。
tests/unit/test_l2_axi_handshake.sv 新增断言，要求最后一个 beat 上 m_wlast 等于 axi_burst_offset == 15。
同一提交还加入了 AXI protocol checker，这与真实写通道协议修复一致。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 burst 写通道上，最后一个 beat 标志必须即使在从端插入等待周期时也仍然与最终实际传输的 beat 对齐。如果 WLAST 来自依赖 ready 的旧计数状态，而不是来自下一次被接受的 burst 索引，那么回压就可能导致最后标志提前、滞后，或在 stall 期间不稳定。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: AXI 写 burst 末 beat 标志
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 多 beat 写 burst 遇到等待周期，导致传输计数器与握手并非每个周期都前进。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让末 beat 标志来自陈旧或依赖 ready 的计数条件，而不是来自下一次 burst 索引。
portability_notes: 这适用于任何具有专门末 beat 标志的 burst 协议，不仅仅是 AXI。
关键错误是把末 beat 检测绑定到了错误的计数周期，或者直接绑定到当前 ready 输入。
保持 burst 数据通路不变，使故障体现为明确的协议时序错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 burst 计数器以及驱动写通道末 beat 标志的逻辑。
把末 beat 条件改成引用旧计数值加 ready 条件，或其他使用陈旧状态而不是下一拍被接受 beat 编号的写法。
保持计数器更新逻辑不变，这样 stall 时数据推进与末标志就会产生偏差。
使用带等待周期的 burst 场景来暴露该协议违例。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L2 AXI 写传输状态机中的 WLAST 生成
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复让 axi_bus.m_wlast 在 state_nxt 为 STATE_WRITE_TRANSFER 且 burst_offset_nxt 等于 BURST_BEATS - 1 时拉起，移除了旧逻辑中对 s_wready 和 burst_offset_ff == BURST_BEATS - 2 的依赖。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 l2_axi_bus_interface.sv 中，把 axi_bus.m_wlast 改回旧表达式，让它重新依赖 axi_bus.s_wready 和前一拍 burst_offset_ff，而不是 burst_offset_nxt。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在写通道出现回压时，末 beat 标志会与数据 beat 失配，造成 AXI 协议违例，并可能引发写回损坏或写响应路径卡死。
evidence_for_injection: 该 DUT 改动是对 WLAST 生成表达式的窄修复，适合直接反向注入。
新增单元断言精确检查了末 beat 对齐这一点。
修复后的逻辑引用 next counter state，这正是抵御 wait state 的标准做法。
notes: 这是很好的可复用故障模型，因为许多存储总线都会遇到同样的 counter 与 handshake 的末 beat 竞态。
不需要更大范围的回退，单行反向修改就足够。
